# EventWizz

> EventWizz hosts white-label event booking websites for UK venues and promoters. Each site lists a venue's locations and events and takes bookings and payments online.

## Pages

- [Home](/): venue home — a list of locations, or the events for a single-location venue
- [Blog](/blog): venue news and articles, when enabled
- [Contact](/contact): venue contact details and enquiry form
- [Policies](/policies): terms and conditions, privacy policy and refund policy

## URL patterns

- [Location events](/): `/{location-slug}` — upcoming events in a city or venue
- [Event detail](/): `/{location-slug}/events/{event-slug}` — a single event with booking

## About

- [EventWizz platform](https://eventwizz.com): the company behind these booking sites
